units.name: 골핌불
units.pose: 기존 고유 무장·행동과 숙인 고개 유지
units.prompt: ONE production transparent pixel GAME TOKEN, same exact number of characters as INPUT1; never add the neutral template as another figure. INPUT1 supplies exact identity/clothes/palette/hair/gear, elevated-front viewpoint and distinct original action. INPUT2 ORIGINAL SPECIES skeleton supplies immutable skull/shoulder/pelvis/knee/ankle bone lengths and proportions, crisp pixel density, stepped dark outlines and short color ramps. Dress input2 bones as input1; no changing bones into different species or inflating skull, no long-human legs on hobbits/goblins. Fat/slim/muscle variation by width. Keep all original hair/helmet despite bald neutral skeleton. HIGH-ANGLE FRONT camera DOWN40–45deg, visible crown and both shoulder TOPS; head DEEPLY BOWED further so eyes hidden by hair/hat/hood/brow and face only small lower fragment. Preserve original body lean/action and distinctive weapons; do not substitute generic upright template walk. Full silhouettes and ALL weapon/hat/staff tips inside inner80percent canvas with generous transparent margins. Body centered ignoring gear. No circular base/floor/shadow/scenery/glow/text/UI/watermark. Character: 골핌불 (golfimbul). Original iron spiked face-covering helmet and black plate armour, burgundy waistcloth, big spiked iron mace held above shoulder, all mace points inside margins; compact goblin/large orc identity exactly source.
